description: Updates one asset to the supplied state. Currently supports Strategy title and ordered Markdown sections. The input uses the revision and complete section state returned by fetch with include_asset: true; this read depends on the advertised include_asset parameter. Applies atomically at the supplied revision; conflicts require a fresh fetch and reconciliation. Supplying sections replaces the collection: omitted sections are deleted and new sections receive IDs. Unchanged section IDs and comment anchors are preserved. Edits touching pending review changes fail; detached discussions are reported. Requires write consent and Strategy management rights. Does not publish or run a service. Uncertain outcomes require readback and reconciliation before another write.

sections.description: Complete desired ordered section collection. Omitted existing IDs are deleted; array order is saved. Preserve every section to keep. Omit this field to leave all sections unchanged.

content.description: Section Markdown; empty clears its body

id.description: Existing section ID from fetch; omit only for a new section
The report:<id> reference returned by search, fetch or create_asset

revision.description: asset.revision from the latest fetch with include_asset: true; stale revisions fail without writes
